Replace.Text: WW2 Overhaul

Simplified HOI4-style WW2 ruleset. Use with a real Europe map (subscribe: TSL Huge Europe by Fidel Casserole — Workshop). Domination only, Industrial start, oil, doctrines, stubbornness, predefined territories.
WW2 ruleset locks start to Industrial (or Modern).
WW2 Starting Territory

Choose your predefined country. Cities are seeded after load on a real Europe TSL map. Pick the matching leader in the civ list (e.g. Serbia leaders for Serbia). AUTO = seed from the leader you picked.
Auto (from leader)
Uses the civilization you selected.
Berlin + core German cities. Play as Germany.
London + British Isles. Play as England / Scotland.
Paris + French cities. Play as France.
Rome + Italian cities. Play as Trajan / Rome.
Madrid + Iberian cities. Play as Spain.
Soviet Union / Russia
Moscow + western Russia. Play as Russia.
Warsaw + Polish cities. Play as Poland.
Budapest. Play as Hungary.
Serbia / Yugoslavia
Belgrade + Serbian cities. Play as Serbia pack leaders.
Athens area. Play as Greece / Macedon.
Amsterdam area. Play as Netherlands.
Norwegian coast. Play as Norway.
Stockholm area. Play as Sweden.
Lisbon. Play as Portugal.
Egypt (North Africa)
Nile / North Africa. Play as Egypt.
